answer: Duplicate identities collapse because replaying one entropy stream costs a full bond slashing plus forfeited stake, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a hardware-attested kernel hash, and every epoch it performs a costly voyage of verification: submitting zero-knowledge proofs of distinct physical entropy sources, like sable grain patterns scanned at registered ports. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
